info.name: Weavr Multi Product BackOffice Access Token Linked Accounts API

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset value for paging, indicating the initial item number to be returned from the data set satisfying the given criteria. Leave out to fetch the first page of results.

params.name: limit
params.description: The limit of the results for paging, starting at the offset. Limit is always capped at 100.

params.name: profileId
params.description: Filter by the managed account/card profile. Leave out to fetch all managed accounts/card.

params.name: friendlyName
params.description:
Filter by the managed account/card friendly name. Leave out to fetch all managed accounts/card.

The exact name must be provided, as wildcards are not supported.

params.name: currency
params.description:
Filter by the managed account/card currency.

Currencies are expressed as an ISO 4217 code. Leave out to fetch all managed accounts/card.

params.name: createdFrom
params.description: Filter for managed accounts/cards created after `createdFrom` timestamp. Timestamp is expressed in Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision. Leave out to fetch all managed accounts/cards.

params.name: createdTo
params.description: Filter for managed accounts/cards created before `createdTo` timestamp. Timestamp is expressed in Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision. Leave out to fetch all managed accounts/cards.

params.name: tag
params.description: Filter by the managed account/card tag. The exact tag must be provided, as wildcards are not supported. Leave out to fetch all managed accounts/card.

items.docs: Retrieves all the Linked Accounts belonging to the logged-in Identity.

A Linked Account is an entity in the Weavr system that represents an external bank account or PSP account which the Identity has verified that they own and control. This feature enables users to perform transactions, such as outgoing and incoming wire transfers, between their Linked Accounts and their Managed Accounts in a way that can be recorded as a self-to-self transfer.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the Linked Account.

items.docs:
Unlinks a linked account identified by the `linked_account_id`.

This action is not reversible and if the buyer wants to use this linked account again to fund payment runs, they will have to re-link the account. More information on how to link an account can be found [here](https://docs.weavr.io/payment-run/instruments/link-account/).

Allows the verification or rejection of a linked account run
by specifying the account ID. This operation updates the status
of a linked account to either VERIFIED or REJECTED.
This tool is used to simulate internal verification for linked accounts by Account ID.
